commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
90+1' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Matteo Marcenaro ignores the protests.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

88' The shots on goal statistics – 9:2.

78' Problems for Gian Piero Gasperini as Devyne Rensch is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) replaces him.
77' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) sees a yellow card from Matteo Marcenaro after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
75' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) latches on to the corner kick inside the box, but his header crashes against the crossbar! The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
75' Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) will take the corner.

71' Matias Soule will be replaced by Robinio Vaz (AS Roma).

70' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.

67' Marco Carnesecchi pulls off a fantastic save! Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out.
66' Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
65' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Ederson (Atalanta) for a tough tackle.

63' Marco Carnesecchi was forced into action to thwart Donyell Malen (AS Roma). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot towards the roof of the net but couldn't beat the keeper.
62' A corner kick by Atalanta is thwarted by the well prepared Mile Svilar (AS Roma).
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) comes onto the pitch so that Gianluca Mancini can be given a rest.

60' Substitution. Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) replaces Stephan El Shaarawy.
58' AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
58' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) drives a shot towards the left side of the goal from inside the box, but Marco Carnesecchi leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
56' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle as Ederson (Atalanta) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
54' That's the end of the game for Raoul Bellanova, who is replaced by Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta).
54' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
53' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but Mile Svilar comes off his line to gather the ball.
50' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
49' A player from Atalanta commits a rough challenge. Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
47' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Raffaele Palladino gives a chance to Honest Ahanor and Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is off.
46' Raffaele Palladino makes a half-time substitution. Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) comes on in place of Giorgio Scalvini.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is replaced by Nicola Zalewski.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 1 Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and slams the ball into the top right corner. What a special shot.
42' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
40' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
39' A pass from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is intercepted by Mile Svilar and the move breaks down.
38' Atalanta players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
35' The attendance is 61474.

33' Ederson (Atalanta) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Mile Svilar inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.

32' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
31' Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
28' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
27' The total number of attempts is 5:2.
25' The referee points to the corner flag and Atalanta will take a corner.

24' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Marco Carnesecchi anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
23' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
22' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
20' Atalanta concede a free kick following a bad challenge. AS Roma are awarded a free kick.
18' It will be a corner kick for AS Roma.
18' Matias Soule (AS Roma) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Marco Carnesecchi easily deals with the threat.
16' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
15' Unlucky! A great strike from Matias Soule (AS Roma) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
14' Matteo Marcenaro sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
14' The Atalanta players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.

12' 0 - 1 Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) strikes the ball towards goal after latching onto a defence-splitting pass on the edge of the penalty box and his shot sails inside the left post to leave the goalkeeper completely stranded!
10' Atalanta keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
8' The ball is behind the touchline and AS Roma will take a throw-in.
5' The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
3' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Matteo Marcenaro saw the whole situation. Atalanta are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
